description: fmt file rewrites a document in the canonical layout in place: one node per line (a ; splits them), four spaces per level, single spaces between entries, names bare where they read back as themselves, a property's value after its type annotation, comments kept where they stand (a trailing one, one on a block's { line, a block comment before a node on its line, a multi-line block comment as written), at most one empty line between items, an empty children block as {}, a slashdashed entry and block as written, a header that outgrows its line filled onto continuation lines two levels in, a long single-paragraph string as a multi-line string wrapped through whitespace escapes, a hand-wrapped paragraph keeping its lines, strings raw only where that saves escapes, numbers as spelled, and a line's trailing whitespace inside a string kept; nothing is printed
